decisions.reason: As a low-cost design variant closely tied to the core drainage range and still visible after launch, it likely remains worth keeping because its option value exceeds its carrying cost.
This product fits the firm's strategic push toward modern seamless and barrier-free bathroom solutions, so its continued market presence suggests enough promise to justify keeping it.

The newer pump-drain concept is more uncertain and the firm has already pruned a similar pump-assisted line, but as a recent launch it still offers learning value that narrowly supports keeping it for now.
